# PrimeNG field properties

These keys go inside `props`. Everything else about a field — its `key`,
`type`, `label`, validation and logic — is adapter independent and documented
in the core skill.

## `input`

Rendered by `PrimeInputFieldComponent`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `variant` | `'outlined' \| 'filled'` | no | `outlined` | Input variant style |
